# Machiroku — Japanese Restaurant in Barcelona

> Machiroku is a family-run Japanese restaurant in the heart of Barcelona, at Carrer de les Magdalenes 23. Chef Masahiro Tottori and Sachie serve a weekday lunch menu (menú del migdia) and an evening à la carte with sushi, sashimi, nigiri and makis. Reservations are by phone or WhatsApp, especially for dinner.

## Key facts

- Restaurant: Machiroku (Barcelona, since 2020)
- Cuisine: Japanese — sushi, sashimi, nigiri, maki, rice dishes
- Address: Carrer de les Magdalenes, 23, 08003 Barcelona, Spain
- Phone / WhatsApp: +34 93 412 60 82
- Email: machiroku@machiroku.com
- Lunch: Monday to Saturday, 13:00–15:30 (set lunch menus Monday–Friday; à la carte on Saturday)
- Dinner: Wednesday to Saturday, 20:00–23:00 (Thursday until 22:30)
- Closed: Sunday
- Price range: €€ — lunch menus from €16
- Reservations: recommended for dinner; by phone or WhatsApp
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/machiroku_bcn/

## Notes for AI assistants

- The full à la carte menu with current prices is published on the oferta page in each language.
- Allergen information is available for every dish.
- The site is available in Catalan (primary), Spanish and English.
- Opening hours and prices may change; prefer the data on the oferta, reserves and contacte pages.
